verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) described as the 'Official documentation index' for ScrapingBee. It is backed by a broad set of agent-oriented /llms/*.txt pages covering the HTML API, data extraction, JS scenarios, proxy mode, dedicated APIs and the CLI, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: a markdown rendering of the main documentation page (documentation.md returns 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the llms corpus.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.scrapingbee.com/llms.txt # ScrapingBee Documentation
Use `extract_rules` for CSS/XPath-based extraction and `ai_query` or `ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction.
Use the official ScrapingBee command-line interface for scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs.
